thread:
Priya: @Raj thanks for the details — Cygnus is seeing 429s + some 401s during their promo spike. Root says baseline ~120 QPS, recent sustained peak ~1.8k QPS for ~10m. Pool: dedicated, 4 GPUs, autoscale min=2 max=8, target_util=0.7. They attached a curl that returns 429s repeatedly. Can eng confirm saturation vs auth churn?

Raj (Cygnus): saw 429s start at 14:03 UTC, lasted ~7-9m. Also had two 401s when clients retried quickly. We don't rotate tokens frequently. Hoping this is capacity, not our SDK.

ops-bot: Alert: dedicated-pool-cygnus saturated (pool_id: dp-0892), 14:02:48 UTC -> 14:10:12 UTC, 429 rate 18% of requests.

Lucas: quick ask — can anyone paste the autoscale event timeline and queue depth? Curious if scaler couldn't spin up fast enough. Also share any gateway auth errors.

Marta: copied a short snapshot from infra: GPU util on pool at spike median 88-94%, request queue depth spiked to 350, avg latency pre-429 ~420ms then tail >2s, autoscaler launched new nodes but first available only ~120s after threshold due to image pull + model warmup. Auth 401s correlate with a burst of token refreshes from a small client fleet (see logs).

Marta: snippet: ```
14:02:30 grpc_reqs: 1850 qps
14:03:10 queue_depth: 312
14:04:15 autoscale: scale_up requested -> +2
14:06:15 node_ready -> model_warmup 70s
14:08:40 429_rate: 0.18
14:09:50 scale_up complete
```

Priya: so root causes look like (1) pool under-provisioned for their burst profile + long warmup and (2) token-refresh storm causing a small % of 401s and subsequent retries adding load. Both combined pushed queue and triggered 429s.

Lucas: immediate mitigation options: (A) increase min_instances to 4 (from 2) for campaign windows, (B) lower target_util to 0.6 so autoscaler triggers earlier, (C) add short-lived burst capacity (+2) to absorb spikes, (D) recommend client-side backoff for retries to avoid token churn. Which should we apply now?

Marta: we can patch config now for a scheduled pre-warm: bump min_instances to 4 and add +2 burst slots. That will reduce first-minute pressure. Also suggest adding a quicker scale cooldown tweak for this customer's pool to allow faster successive scale_up (temp change).

Raj (Cygnus): ok to try increasing min and burst. Also we'll roll out a small client SDK change to stagger token refresh by random jitter in next 30m.

Priya: action plan agreed — short-term (apply immediately):
- increase min_instances 2 -> 4 for dp-0892
- add 2 burst replicas (burst pool)
- lower autoscale target_util from 0.7 -> 0.6 for next 24h
- create temporary cooldown override to allow faster scale_up
- ask Cygnus to deploy token refresh jitter

Priya: medium-term: evaluate model warmup time and bake smaller warm cache images to reduce model_warmup from ~70s -> ~20-30s; also consider pre-pulling images for scheduled promos.

Marta: I'm on config change now. Will post once applied. Also created follow-up ticket INF-7842 to evaluate warm cache and pre-pull scheduler.

Marta: applied changes at 14:22 UTC: min_instances=4, burst_slots=2, autoscale_target=0.6. Monitoring.

ops-bot: ConfigChange dp-0892: min_instances updated by Marta at 14:22:41 UTC.

Lucas: monitoring dashboard shows queue depth dropping to <40 within 90s of change, GPU util back to 65-72% at 14:24. No visible 429s after 14:25.

Raj (Cygnus): seeing improved success rates in our dashboards, 429s gone. We'll keep jitter rollout and report back tomorrow. Thanks! :tada:

Priya: closing immediate escalation — leaving INF ticket open for warmup optimizations and autoscaler tuning. Assigning to Marta for infra follow-up and to Eng for SDK retry guidance.

Marta: noted, will drive INF-7842 and include runbook changes for promo warmups.

Lucas: FYI, we should add a recommended dedicated pool cookbook for customers with short high spikes: guidance on min_instances, target_util, and burst slots. Will draft.

Priya: thanks team, marking thread resolved for support.
